doc.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Joe Williams's boxing bet on Ezzard Charles
summary: Joe Williams wins a bet with Basie and Terry that Charles would beat Joe Louis.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Joe Williams: the singer with Basie

blocks.x: Did – was Joe Williams working with the band – with the small group too at the Brass Rail? Was he doing things in Chicago?

Yeah. Joe was with the small group. I’ll never forget, because that was the time he bet me and Basie that Ezra Charles was going to beat Joe Louis, and Basie and I laughed at him. He cleaned up on both of us, because Charles did beat him.
Ezra Charles was a big jazz fan. Did you know Ezra Charles?
Yeah. He was supposed to be a bass player, but I didn’t know him real, real well, but I know he was a jazz buff.
